messages:
Maya: Heads-up — planning to pin nova-3.1 into catalog slot 42 tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Will run a small canary then ramp. Please ack if you can own smoke/monitoring.
Sam: I can take smoke at 03:00 UTC. Quick checklist? :thumbsup:
Maya: Checklist: 1) pin model in catalog 2) spawn canary nodes (3) 3) run smoke harness + warmup 4) monitor latency/error dashboards 5) ramp traffic. Pasting commands in case helpful.
Maya: ```bash
# pin model
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/catalog/pin 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"model":"nova-3.1","slot":42,"owner":"eng-ml"}'
# smoke run
python tools/smoke.py --endpoint https://staging.redwood.ai --model nova-3.1 --count 200
```
Jordan: Can we do a small KV warmup after canary spawn? 20-30 short prompts to populate cache.
Liam: Yep, I'll run a warmup job: `jobs/warmup --slot 42 --count 100 --concurrency 4` right after canary is up.
Anna: Rollback plan? what are the triggers to revert pin?
Maya: If request error rate > 2% or p50/p95 latency regress by > 30% sustained for 10m, we revert. Revert command: `curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/catalog/unpin -d '{"slot":42,"alias":"previous"}'` and route alias back. Escalate to eng-oncall if rollback fails.
Sam: I'll watch dashboards + logs. Add me to runbook and notify channel. @Jordan @Liam please confirm you're ready.
deploy-bot: Deployment window scheduled: 2025-08-18T03:00:00Z; canary_nodes=3; canary_timeout=20m
Jordan: Also suggest temporary `cache_ttl=60s` to avoid noisy misses during ramp. I'll push that in the canary config.
Maya: Ack. Also opened a quick PR for a small catalog pinning UI tweak — needs one review from @Sam before merge.
Sam: Reviewing now; small nits, will approve in ~15m.
Maya: Proposed traffic ramp: 10% for 10m -> 50% for 15m -> 100%. Any objections?
Liam: Fine by me. Will ensure autoscaler has headroom for the 50% step.
Anna: Note: the rerank endpoint is sensitive for search flows. Let's validate top-k stability in the smoke results.
Maya: Will run the eval suite against the canary and upload results: s3://redwood-evals/nova-3.1/presmoke-1789999999.json
Sam: LGTM. I'll be online during the window and keep an eye on errors.
Jordan: I'll run warmup + smoke harness and post short logs to the thread.
Maya: Great — final plan above. If no objections by EOD today I'll lock the window and trigger the scheduler.
Sam: No objections from me.
Anna: +1
Jordan: +1
deploy-bot: Reminder: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/catalog-pin
Maya: Thanks everyone. Will post the runbook snippet and the timeline in the deploy ticket shortly. :rocket:
